messages:
anya: Heads-up 10 min sync: we need a tight, testable plan for Private (VPC/on-prem) launch focusing on three customer asks: egress IP stability during upgrades, a documented rollback choreography, and a tiny airgap bundle for compliance customers. Trying to avoid scope creep.

jordan: Agreed. From eng side, main risk is state warming after operator revert. Customers fear a split-brain or cold-cache spike. We should define an expected "service-slope" after deploy and an SLO for recovery.

rachel: Field note: customers expect a "no-change" migration when possible. If egress IPs move, they want 1) BGP fallback recipe, 2) a comms template that says when IPs might change, and 3) verification steps they can run. I'll collect 3 beta customers who need this.

lee: Technical options for egress: 1) preserve-ip via iptables SNAT mapping + sticky host routing, 2) announce old IPs from a relay during upgrade, 3) let customers bring their own NAT gateway. Option 1 is the least external-facing change but needs host-affinity and a simple toggle.

jordan: Can we make preserve-ip the default for 2 sprints then require opt-in to opt-out? Ops complexity increases but field will love the default. Also we need metrics: "egress-ip-shift-count" and "post-upgrade-p95-latency".

anya: Proposal: sprint A (2 weeks) = implement preserve-egress toggle + rollback runbook + canary job. sprint B = slim airgap bundle (< 200MB compressed) + final comms + KMS integration proof-of-concept. Gate checklist attached in confluence (will paste link).

deploy-bot: Deployment note: new canary pipeline template created: pipelines/private-upgrade-canary. See: https://ci.internal/redwood/pipeline/priv-upgrade-canary-1797654321

lee: Canary idea: after operator roll, run a lightweight workload that asserts: tokenized responses match a checksum baseline AND kv-cache hit-rate >= 80% within 10m. If failed -> auto-rollback. Need to confirm time budget for auto-rollback: 30m?

jordan: 30m max failover window requested by field. Realistic flow: 1) pause new traffic, 2) route to fallback pool, 3) rollback operator, 4) warm primary from preserved cache, 5) resume. We should time-box each step in the runbook.

rachel: I'll require a comms template block: short summary, impact (who sees degraded perf), prep (run connectivity check, confirm peering), rollback expectations, contact list. Example snippet OK? "Planned upgrade: minimal interruption expected; if IPs change, expect 5-15 min reconverge for BGP peers."

anya: Add acceptance criteria (all must be satisfied for beta): "no tenant disconnects during canary in 3 staged rollouts", "egress-ip-shift-count = 0 for preserved mode in 5 sample installs", "airgap bundle size < 200MB + SHA256 checksum published".

jordan: Implementation notes: installer flags: 
```
--network-mode=preserve|relay|external-nat
--egress-preserve=true|false
--airgap=true|false
```
We should bake an installer verify script that prints the final egress IP and a checksum for ops.

lee: Security: for airgap we need optional KMS/HSM hooks but offline mode must not require outbound telemetry by default. Telemetry must be opt-in with hashed install-id. Add data-handling checklist item.

rachel: Field will sign off on beta only if comms + verification steps are shared one week before handoff. I'll schedule the beta window with customers for the week after next.

anya: Owners: jordan -> canary pipeline + runbook + metrics; lee -> egress-preserve implementation + relay recipe; rachel -> comms + beta booking + customer verification checklist. I'll coordinate gating review and legal signoff for KMS wording.

jordan: Risk register quick hits: "cache-warm time > budget"; "BGP not reconverging in expected window"; "airgap bundle > target". I'll add tickets and link to sprint board.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: PROJ-6243 preserve-egress-default-mode; PROJ-6244 upgrade-canary-workflow; PROJ-6245 airgap-bundle-size-optimization.

anya: Next sync Fri 11am PT for gate review. If someone hits a blocker before then, post logs in this thread. Keep messages short. :white_check_mark:

lee: Will prototype preserve-ip flow in lab today and post results.

jordan: Starting the canary template; will add auto-rollback hook and sample logs.

rachel: Booking 3 beta customers, will PM them the comms draft and share acceptance checklists here.

anya: Thanks team. Focus: deliver preserve-egress + rollback docs in sprint A, airgap + KMS in sprint B.
